notes.title: Eternal Radiance Full Release Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33421640/6a32480093b8bdbcde9e0ce8562b8fd72eb3a92d.png[/img]

This version 1.0 update contains the final chapter in the game, and the game is now complete. 

We have made numerous finetuning adjustments to the game and have also localized it into Japanese. 

Our next step will be porting the game to consoles. 
 
We hope you have enjoyed playing Eternal Radiance and we appreciate your support throughout the game’s development.

tags.feature: - We have made numerous finetuning adjustments to the game and have also localized it into Japanese.
- Our next step will be porting the game to consoles.

notes.title: Chapter 4 Beta Test Build
notes.content:
The beta test build for chapter 4 in the game is now available for testing.

There's lots of various changes and improvements since the last update. For feedback, you can let us know over on the steam forums, email or on discord.

Some assets have not been completed yet which is the sound effects

A) Boss Character - You'll know who this is when you try the game.
B) Goblin Mage Purple Breathe Attack

To access the beta test build on Steam, here are the steps.

Right click on Eternal Radiance on your Steam Library -> Select Properties -> Select the Betas Tab -> Select the test branch.

[b]Main Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted target lock-on mechanics so that it now uses line of sight as a conditional check.
[*] Many various improvements & finetuning adjustments
[*] Optimized performance in several areas such as memory management
[*] Added potion of return to world map
[*] Add turning animations for big monsters
[*] Finetuned & remade some special effects for characters
[*] Adjusted heavy golem's basic attack animation's anticipation frames to be slightly faster
[*] Nerfed celeste's melee stun talent slightly
[*] Your party members will now teleport to your current position if they are too far away even if you're in combat.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience!

[*] Add turning animations for big monsters

[*] Nerfed celeste's melee stun talent slightly

notes.title: Build v0.05R1 Changelog
notes.content:
Build v0.05R1 Changelog

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33421640/b59ea0bf7b5ac13f96d3260e62db86e4a37e8ccf.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Localization Text Changes
[*] Added heavy attack mechanics for the player (heavy attack restores mana on hit, and works against enemy guard)
[*] You can now guard counter from any state,(previously you had to be in the idle state)
[*] You can now attack earlier while in the dash charge state
[*] Basic ranged projectile is now an ability called Azure Shot. You can use this ability while moving as well.
[*] Some finetuning adjustments to the kylia boss
[*] You can now use right mouse button to exit out of UI menu screen.
[*] Max MP & MP Regen stats on items have been nerfed since you can now regain mana by using heavy attack. Party member will now restore more mana on basic attacks
[*] Added potion of regret so that you can reset talent tree points (available in chapter 3 onwards)
[*] Party members will no longer start combat by themselves and will only do so when you're already in combat
[*] Add UI menu wrapping for inventory / shop / quest / help / saveload menus
[*] Many other minor various improvement & bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Build v0.04R7 Changelog

Build v0.04R7 Changelog
[list][*] Adjusted the skit UI HUD component to be more noticeable.
[*] Adjusted some of the forest boss attacks's hitbox timing to be more accurate.
[*] Adjusted celeste's stun handling to fix the stun-locking problem when you are being attacked by multiple enemies or damage sources.
[*] Adjusted airbourne handling code so that party members will be pushed away if u jump on them.
[*] Improved airborne handling code so that it will push enemies / party members away before collision happens instead of after collision has been detected
[*] Fixed a minor bug whereby party members were reviving with 0.15HP instead of 15% HP.
[*] Adjusted default goblin's jump attack to disable collision temporarily and have consistent behavior with other types of jump attacks.
[*] You can now set how often your party member use their abilities in the abilities screen
[*] Enemies that are on top of another enemy will now be pushed away
[*] You can now enter a gameplay location from save points via the world map if you have interacted with the save point
[*] Refactored skit dialogue handling so that skit dialogues will now repeat 2 times instead of disappearing if you missed them.
[*] Adjusted snow wolf so that it attacks more frequently
[*] Fixed a bug with reflect projectile talent tree not reflecting the projectile directly to the enemy target
[*] Added the "Interact" controls keybinding to the options controls screen so that you can remap the controls.
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Build v0.04R5 Changelog
notes.content:
Build v0.04R5 Changelog
[list]
[*] Added conflict checking for default controls gameplay input mapping (this means u can re-assign the default mouse inputs under controls)
[*] You can now remap the controls for the secondary party buttons under Input (keyboard)
[*] Fix bugs in the synthesizing UI screen.
[*] Fixed a bug whereby mystic scrolls and synthesized relics's rarity property weren't been set properly after creation.

[*] Adjusted guard counter to be a little bit easier to use in terms of timing.
[*] Relics can no longer be leveled up and synthesizing them only allows you to add additional enchantment properties now.
[*] Combining a scroll and relic together no longer uses the item with the highest level and instead use the stats from the main item.
[*] Changed the synthesize_fail sound effect
[*] Tweaked Equipped indicator on the UI screens to show which character has equipped the item.
[*] Adjusted enemy's hit animations to be more responsive to the player's attacks
[*] Added an UI animation for when the player's finisher bar is full to make it easier to notice that it can be used.
[*] Adjusted player & party member's damage abilities so only some of them will cause enemy flying knockbacks (for example, celeste's ice strike will only cause flying knockbacks on the final ice strike).
[/list]
